name: Schiaparelli
about: Schiaparelli (2016-017, ESA), launched 2016 Mar 14. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.962 au and aphelion 1.385 au against GCAT's 0.967 and 1.375
